variables.parserQuery:
// =============================================================================
// ASim_AbstractEvent: every Abstract event, wherever this solution's routes stored it
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One row per stored Abstract event, with ASIM-aligned column names, read from:
//   - AbstractEventLogs_CL: every event no other route took (all events when the
//     store-once option is off);
//   - the ASim tables, only with the store-once option on (otherwise the same
//     events are already in AbstractEventLogs_CL): Abstract rows only, recognised
//     by AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId;
//   - each lane table whose events are stored only there (the store-once option
//     and excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim both on): OktaV2_CL (okta), CommonSecurityLog
//     and Syslog rows with CollectorHostName 'Abstract' (csl-cef, csl-acs, syslog),
//     AWSCloudTrail (aws-cloudtrail), CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL (crowdstrike-hosts), and
//     Abstract rows in ASimAlertEventLogs, ASimDhcpEventLogs and
//     ASimUserManagementActivityLogs. OktaV2_CL, AWSCloudTrail and
//     CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL carry no Abstract marker, so rows Microsoft's own
//     connector writes into them are read too.
// The lake table (Auxiliary plan) is not read: the query API does not serve it.
// The deployment fills in __ABSTRACT_READ_ASIM__ and __ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__
// from the routes it built, so the parser never counts one event twice.
// AbstractSourceTable names the table each row came from. AbstractEvent is one bag per row in every case, so tiles that
// read AbstractEvent.product, .severity or .aggregation_count work on all of them. risk_score, identity and tags are carried
// only on rows in AbstractEventLogs_CL, so a tile that measures them counts those rows.
// =============================================================================
let ASim_AbstractEvent = (disabled: bool = false) {
    let readAsim = __ABSTRACT_READ_ASIM__;
    let nativeVendors = dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__);
    let abstractRows = AbstractEventLogs_CL
        | extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
        | extend e = AbstractEvent
        | extend
            EventVendor      = tostring(e.vendor),
            EventProduct     = tostring(e.product),
            EventType        = coalesce(tostring(e.type), tostring(e.acs_type)),
            EventResult      = tostring(e.action),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(e.severity),
            EventMessage     = coalesce(tostring(e.message), Message),
            EventCount       = toreal(e.aggregation_count),
            EventRiskScore   = toreal(e.risk_score),
            SrcIpAddr        = coalesce(tostring(e.source_ipv4), tostring(e.source_ipv6), tostring(e.source_address)),
            DstIpAddr        = coalesce(tostring(e.dest_ipv4), tostring(e.dest_ipv6), tostring(e.dest_address)),
            SrcPortNumber    = toint(e.source_port),
            DstPortNumber    = toint(e.dest_port),
            DvcIpAddr        = coalesce(tostring(e.host_ipv4), tostring(e.host_ipv6), tostring(e.host_address)),
            DvcHostname      = tostring(e.host_name),
            ActorUsername    = coalesce(tostring(e.user_name), tostring(e.user_id)),
            TargetUsername   = coalesce(tostring(e.user.target.name), tostring(e['user.target.name'])),
            UserAgent        = tostring(e.user_agent),
            AbstractEventId  = coalesce(tostring(e.id), tostring(e.acs_id)),
            AbstractDataset  = tostring(e.data_stream.dataset),
            AbstractIdentity = tostring(e.identity),
            AbstractMatchedRules = e.matched_rules,
            AbstractTags     = e.tags,
            AbstractTimestamp = coalesce(todatetime(e['@timestamp']), todatetime(e.timestamp)),
            AbstractSourceTable = 'AbstractEventLogs_CL';
    let asimRows = union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs,
            ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs,
            (ASimAlertEventLogs | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'asim-alert')),
            (ASimDhcpEventLogs | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'asim-dhcp')),
            (ASimUserManagementActivityLogs | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'asim-user-management')),
            (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime)[])
        | extend _row = pack_all(), _af = column_ifexists('AdditionalFields', dynamic(null))
        | where readAsim and isnotnull(_af.AbstractEventId)
        | extend
            EventVendor      = tostring(column_ifexists('EventVendor', '')),
            EventProduct     = tostring(column_ifexists('EventProduct', '')),
            EventType        = tostring(column_ifexists('EventType', '')),
            EventResult      = tostring(column_ifexists('EventResult', '')),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(column_ifexists('EventSeverity', '')),
            EventMessage     = tostring(column_ifexists('EventMessage', '')),
            EventCount       = toreal(column_ifexists('EventCount', int(null))),
            EventRiskScore   = real(null),
            SrcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('SrcIpAddr', '')),
            DstIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('DstIpAddr', '')),
            SrcPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('SrcPortNumber', int(null))),
            DstPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('DstPortNumber', int(null))),
            DvcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('DvcIpAddr', '')),
            DvcHostname      = tostring(column_ifexists('DvcHostname', '')),
            ActorUsername    = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ActorUsername', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('TargetUsername', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('Username', ''))),
            TargetUsername   = tostring(column_ifexists('TargetUsername', '')),
            UserAgent        = tostring(column_ifexists('HttpUserAgent', '')),
            AbstractEventId  = tostring(_af.AbstractEventId),
            AbstractDataset  = tostring(_af.AbstractDataset),
            AbstractIdentity = '',
            AbstractMatchedRules = _af.AbstractMatchedRules,
            AbstractTags     = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            AbstractSourceTable = tostring(column_ifexists('Type', ''))
        | extend AbstractEvent = bag_merge(pack('vendor', EventVendor, 'product', EventProduct, 'severity', tolower(EventSeverity),
            'aggregation_count', EventCount, 'matched_rules', AbstractMatchedRules), _row);
    let oktaRows = union isfuzzy=true (OktaV2_CL | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'okta')), (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime)[] | where false)
        | extend _row = pack_all()
        | extend
            EventVendor      = 'Okta',
            EventProduct     = 'Okta',
            EventType        = tostring(column_ifexists('EventOriginalType', '')),
            EventResult      = tostring(column_ifexists('EventResult', '')),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(column_ifexists('EventSeverity', '')),
            EventMessage     = tostring(column_ifexists('EventMessage', '')),
            EventCount       = real(1),
            EventRiskScore   = real(null),
            SrcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('SrcIpAddr', '')),
            DstIpAddr        = '',
            SrcPortNumber    = int(null),
            DstPortNumber    = int(null),
            DvcIpAddr        = '',
            DvcHostname      = '',
            ActorUsername    = tostring(column_ifexists('ActorUsername', '')),
            TargetUsername   = '',
            UserAgent        = tostring(column_ifexists('HttpUserAgent', '')),
            AbstractEventId  = '',
            AbstractDataset  = '',
            AbstractIdentity = '',
            AbstractMatchedRules = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTags     = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            AbstractSourceTable = 'OktaV2_CL'
        | extend AbstractEvent = bag_merge(pack('vendor', EventVendor, 'product', EventProduct, 'severity', tolower(EventSeverity),
            'aggregation_count', EventCount), _row);
    // The lanes into Microsoft's own tables. Columns are read with column_ifexists so a missing table or column is empty.
    let laneRows = union isfuzzy=true
            (CommonSecurityLog | where (set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'csl-cef') or set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'csl-acs')) and CollectorHostName == 'Abstract'
                | extend _v = DeviceVendor, _p = DeviceProduct, _t = Activity, _r = DeviceAction, _s = LogSeverity, _m = Message,
                    _src = SourceIP, _dst = DestinationIP, _sp = SourcePort, _dp = DestinationPort, _dvc = DeviceName, _u = SourceUserName, _src_t = 'CommonSecurityLog'),
            (Syslog | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'syslog') and CollectorHostName == 'Abstract'
                | extend _v = '', _p = ProcessName, _t = Facility, _r = '', _s = SeverityLevel, _m = SyslogMessage,
                    _src = HostIP, _dst = '', _sp = int(null), _dp = int(null), _dvc = Computer, _u = '', _src_t = 'Syslog'),
            (AWSCloudTrail | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'aws-cloudtrail')
                | extend _v = 'AWS', _p = EventSource, _t = EventName, _r = iff(isempty(ErrorCode), 'Success', 'Failure'), _s = '', _m = EventName,
                    _src = SourceIpAddress, _dst = '', _sp = int(null), _dp = int(null), _dvc = '', _u = UserIdentityArn, _src_t = 'AWSCloudTrail'),
            (CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'crowdstrike-hosts')
                | extend _v = 'CrowdStrike', _p = 'Falcon', _t = 'host', _r = '', _s = '', _m = '',
                    _src = tostring(column_ifexists('LocalIp', '')), _dst = '', _sp = int(null), _dp = int(null), _dvc = tostring(column_ifexists('Hostname', '')), _u = '', _src_t = 'CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL'),
            (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime)[] | where false)
        | extend _row = pack_all()
        | extend
            EventVendor      = tostring(column_ifexists('_v', '')),
            EventProduct     = tostring(column_ifexists('_p', '')),
            EventType        = tostring(column_ifexists('_t', '')),
            EventResult      = tostring(column_ifexists('_r', '')),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(column_ifexists('_s', '')),
            EventMessage     = tostring(column_ifexists('_m', '')),
            EventCount       = real(1),
            EventRiskScore   = real(null),
            SrcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('_src', '')),
            DstIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('_dst', '')),
            SrcPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('_sp', int(null))),
            DstPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('_dp', int(null))),
            DvcIpAddr        = '',
            DvcHostname      = tostring(column_ifexists('_dvc', '')),
            ActorUsername    = tostring(column_ifexists('_u', '')),
            TargetUsername   = '',
            UserAgent        = '',
            AbstractEventId  = '',
            AbstractDataset  = '',
            AbstractIdentity = '',
            AbstractMatchedRules = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTags     = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            AbstractSourceTable = tostring(column_ifexists('_src_t', ''))
        | extend AbstractEvent = bag_merge(pack('vendor', EventVendor, 'product', EventProduct, 'severity', tolower(EventSeverity),
            'aggregation_count', EventCount), _row)
        | project-away _v, _p, _t, _r, _s, _m, _src, _dst, _sp, _dp, _dvc, _u, _src_t;
    union isfuzzy=true abstractRows, asimRows, oktaRows, laneRows
    | where not(disabled)
    | project-away _af, _row
    | project-reorder
        TimeGenerated, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventType, EventResult, EventSeverity,
        SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, SrcPortNumber, DstPortNumber, ActorUsername, EventMessage,
        EventRiskScore, AbstractEventId, AbstractIdentity, AbstractSourceTable
};
ASim_AbstractEvent

variables.ruleHighOrCritical:
// Abstract Security - High or Critical event.
// Reads the tables directly and calls no workspace function (Defender custom detections cannot call them).
// The Abstract table holds what no ASIM dataflow took (findings, alerts and unmapped events); the ASim
// tables hold the Abstract events the ASIM dataflows took, recognised by AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId.
// When the deployment stores a lane's events only in that lane's table (excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim), that table is read
// too: OktaV2_CL, and Abstract rows (CollectorHostName 'Abstract') in CommonSecurityLog and Syslog. Abstract findings on the
// asim-alert lane are read by the rule "Abstract Security - Finding", not here.
let lookback = 1h;
union isfuzzy=true
    (AbstractEventLogs_CL
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | extend AbstractSeverity = tolower(coalesce(severity, tostring(event.severity)))
        | where AbstractSeverity in ("high", "critical")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity, EventProduct = product, EventMessage = message,
            SrcIpAddr = coalesce(source_ipv4, source_ipv6, source_address), ActorUsername = coalesce(user_name, user_id),
            AbstractInsightId = acs_id, SourceTable = "AbstractEventLogs_CL"),
    (union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs,
        ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId) and EventSeverity == "High"
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct, EventMessage = column_ifexists("EventMessage", ""),
            SrcIpAddr = column_ifexists("SrcIpAddr", ""),
            ActorUsername = coalesce(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", ""), column_ifexists("TargetUsername", "")),
            AbstractInsightId = tostring(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId), SourceTable = Type),
    (OktaV2_CL
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where EventSeverity == "High"
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct = "Okta", EventMessage, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername,
            AbstractInsightId = EventOriginalUid, SourceTable = "OktaV2_CL"),
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'csl-cef') or set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'csl-acs')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where CollectorHostName == "Abstract" and (toint(LogSeverity) >= 7 or LogSeverity in~ ("high", "very-high", "critical"))
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct = DeviceProduct, EventMessage = Activity, SrcIpAddr = SourceIP,
            ActorUsername = SourceUserName, AbstractInsightId = "", SourceTable = "CommonSecurityLog"),
    (Syslog
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'syslog')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where CollectorHostName == "Abstract" and SeverityLevel in ("crit", "alert", "emerg")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct = ProcessName, EventMessage = SyslogMessage, SrcIpAddr = HostIP,
            ActorUsername = "", AbstractInsightId = "", SourceTable = "Syslog")
| project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity, EventProduct, EventMessage, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, AbstractInsightId, SourceTable
variables.ruleAuthFailures:
// Abstract - Repeated auth failures followed by success.
// Reads the tables directly and calls no workspace function (Defender custom detections cannot call them).
// Authentication events are in ASimAuthenticationEventLogs when the ASIM dataflows are on, and in the
// Abstract table otherwise (or in both, when the one-copy option is off); one row per Abstract event id.
// When the deployment stores a vendor's events only in that vendor's table (excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim), that table is read too.
let lookback = 1h;
let auth = union isfuzzy=true
    (AbstractEventLogs_CL
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | extend _category = tolower(tostring(event.category)), _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome))
        | where _category has "authentication" or _category has "session" or tolower(action) has_any ("login", "logon", "auth")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractEventId = acs_id, SrcIpAddr = coalesce(source_ipv4, source_ipv6, source_address),
            ActorUsername = coalesce(user_name, user_id), EventProduct = product,
            EventResult = case(_outcome in ("success", "succeeded", "allowed", "allow"), "Success",
                               _outcome in ("failure", "failed", "fail", "denied", "blocked", "deny"), "Failure", "NA")),
    (ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId)
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractEventId = tostring(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId), SrcIpAddr,
            ActorUsername = TargetUsername, EventProduct, EventResult),
    (OktaV2_CL
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where EventOriginalType has_any ("user.session.start", "user.authentication")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractEventId = EventOriginalUid, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, EventProduct = "Okta", EventResult)
    | extend _key = iff(isempty(AbstractEventId), strcat(tostring(TimeGenerated), SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, EventResult), AbstractEventId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by _key;
let failures = auth
    | where EventResult == "Failure"
    | summarize Failures = count(), FailUsers = make_set(ActorUsername, 25) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where Failures >= 10;
let successes = auth
    | where EventResult == "Success"
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, AbstractInsightId = AbstractEventId, EventProduct;
failures
| join kind=inner successes on SrcIpAddr
| where SuccessTime between (TimeGenerated .. (TimeGenerated + 10m))
| where set_has_element(FailUsers, ActorUsername)
| project SuccessTime, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, Failures, EventProduct, AbstractInsightId
| sort by Failures desc

properties.descriptionHtml:
A security data pipeline and agentic SIEM in one platform.

Abstract Security for Microsoft Sentinel sets up, in one Azure deployment, the Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule and AbstractEventLogs_CL table that receive Abstract Security events through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Optional routes write events into Microsoft's ASIM tables, an Auxiliary-plan lake table and vendor tables.

It also installs Microsoft Sentinel content for that data: a data connector page that shows whether Abstract rows are arriving, the ASim_AbstractEvent parser, analytics rules installed disabled, hunting queries, workbooks, and playbooks that call the Abstract API from an incident.

connectorUiConfig.title: Abstract Security (Security Data Pipeline)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: **Abstract Security** delivers normalized security events into Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. This solution deployed the Data Collection Endpoint, the Data Collection Rule and the tables. Events land in AbstractEventLogs_CL and, when the routes are on, in Microsoft's ASim tables and the lane tables you chose (nativeVendors). The status below counts Abstract rows in all of them.

sampleQueries.query:
AbstractEventLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize count() by tostring(AbstractEvent.product)

instructionSteps.description: The deployment created the Data Collection Endpoint, the Data Collection Rule, AbstractEventLogs_CL and the routes you chose, and granted the Abstract app Monitoring Metrics Publisher on the Data Collection Rule. Its outputs list the three values Abstract needs.

Enter the app's Client ID, Client Secret and Tenant ID, then the deployment outputs: **Data Collection Rule ID** (dataCollectionRuleImmutableId), **Data Collection Endpoint** (dataCollectionEndpointUrl) and **Log Stream Name** (Custom-AbstractEventLogs_CL).

properties.displayName: Abstract - Repeated auth failures followed by success
properties.description: Detects a likely successful brute force / password spray: many failed authentication events followed by a success from the same source IP within a short window, using Abstract-normalized auth telemetry (ASim_AbstractEvent). Tune the EventResult terms to your products.

properties.displayName: Abstract - Rare or newly-seen product activity
properties.query:
ASim_AbstractEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by EventProduct, EventVendor
| where Events < 50 and FirstSeen > ago(3d)
| extend Rarity = round(1.0 / Events, 4)
| sort by Events asc

| summarize TotalRisk = sum(EventRiskScore), Events = count(), Products = make_set(EventProduct, 10), SrcIps = make_set(SrcIpAddr, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AbstractIdentity, ActorUsername
| where TotalRisk > 100 and array_length(Products) >= 2
| sort by TotalRisk desc
